basis: Solar emission color computed from the ASTM E490-00 air-mass-zero reference spectrum. Brightness-normalized for a swatch; not an official color or a representation of solar brightness.

source.title: ASTM E490-00 air-mass-zero solar spectral irradiance
source.columns: NewAM0 worksheet, columns A and B: wavelength in micrometres and irradiance in W/m2/micrometre.

conversion.integration: Linearly interpolate solar irradiance onto the CIE 360-830 nm grid at 1 nm. Sum irradiance times each CIE matching function and normalize XYZ to Y=1. All inputs cover the integration interval; no extrapolation.
conversion.chromaticAdaptation: None. Convert the emitted spectrum directly to the sRGB D65 display primaries; do not white-balance the emitter as a reflective surface.
conversion.brightnessNormalization: Divide all three linear sRGB channels by their maximum, preserving channel ratios; apply the standard sRGB transfer function, multiply by 255, and round half up. No hue adjustment or gamut clipping.

display.basis: Authored soft-yellow navigation accent for recognition against the dark sky. The spectral swatch remains in hex and rgb above.
